tools.name: hydrate
tools.description: Expand an origami fold to its full stored content. Use before re-running a tool whose result was folded — re-running may not reproduce it (files change, tests flake). fold_id appears in [origami fold-…] stubs and in hydrate:// links; when a specific link motivated this call, pass its #fragment as anchor.

tools.name: unpin
tools.description: Release a pinned origami fold so it can fold again. Use when pinned content is no longer earning its place in context.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
